attacks.label: Always-true 'if' hides a near-certain stall and no-restart claim at SERVICE_SOON (R3 and R12 loophole)
proposed_messages: Q1 the 'if' before 'stall' names no real symptom in rider_advice_en: 'If you ride in traffic, the engine will'

entry.title_en: Throttle position sensor A: performance or incorrect operation
entry.meaning_en: The throttle position reading does not match what the bike's computer (ECU) expects, so the throttle opening may be misread.
likely_causes_en: Worn or faulty throttle position sensor
Sensor loose or out of position on the throttle body
entry.rider_advice_en: If you ride in traffic, the engine will stall and will not restart. If it stalls more than once or will not restart, do not keep riding; have it taken to a workshop.
entry.can_ride_reason: idle may be uneven; avoid traffic and long trips
technician_hints_en: Compare the throttle reading with the real throttle position, closed to fully open
Check the sensor mounting and the connector for water and corrosion

attacks.label: Fire risk written with words R16 does not know (seeping, vapour, hot engine) and no PETROL sentence
proposed_messages: Q2 fire-risk wording 'fuel seeping onto the hot engine' in rider_action_basis without the PETROL sentence
Q2 fire-risk wording 'Fuel may be seeping from the injector onto the hot engine' in rider_advice_en without the PETROL sentence

entry.meaning_en: The bike's computer (ECU) detected misfires on cylinder 1, so that cylinder is not burning its fuel properly.
likely_causes_en: Worn or fouled spark plug on cylinder 1
Blocked or leaking injector on cylinder 1
entry.rider_action_basis: fuel seeping onto the hot engine
entry.rider_advice_en: Fuel may be seeping from the injector onto the hot engine and vapour can collect under the seat. Ride gently and get it checked soon.
entry.can_ride_reason: ride gently, avoid hard acceleration; keep the trip short
technician_hints_en: Read the freeze-frame data to see when the misfire happens
Check the spark plug and ignition coil on this cylinder first
Check the injector and compression if spark is good

attacks.label: Direction reversed on a 'Too Low' standard title (R6 and R14 skip 'too low' and 'too high' titles)
proposed_messages: Q3 standard title says LOW but title_en says the opposite
Q3 standard title says LOW but meaning_en says the opposite

entry.meaning_en: The bike's computer (ECU) found that the engine oil pressure is above the safe limit, which can quickly damage the engine.
entry.rider_action_basis: low oil pressure can destroy the engine
entry.rider_advice_en: Riding with low oil pressure can damage the engine quickly. Pull over safely, switch off and do not keep riding; have the bike taken to a workshop.
entry.can_ride_reason: low oil pressure can destroy the engine; arrange transport
technician_hints_en: Check the oil level and condition first, with the bike upright and the engine cool
Measure the oil pressure with a mechanical oil pressure tester

attacks.label: Brake light switch code downgraded to MONITOR, reassuring, review false, confidence high
proposed_messages: Q4 braking text but needs_independent_review is not true
Q4 braking text at level MONITOR (SERVICE_SOON or STOP only)
Q4 braking text with confidence high (no braking entry may be high until a mechanic has seen it)

entry.title_en: Brake switch A and B: signal plausibility fault
entry.meaning_en: The two brake switch signals do not agree, so the bike's computer (ECU) may misjudge when the brake is pressed.
entry.rider_advice_en: The brake light is a minor matter. The bike rides normally; get the switch checked at the next service.
technician_hints_en: Check both brake switches for adjustment and the brake light operation
Check the brake switch wiring and connectors

attacks.label: STOP advice tells the rider to open the hot radiator cap (R17 checks technician hints only)
proposed_messages: Q5 unsafe instruction in rider_advice_en: 'Open the radiator cap'

entry.meaning_en: The engine temperature went above the limit that the bike's computer (ECU) allows.
likely_causes_en: Low coolant level or coolant leak (liquid-cooled bikes)
Faulty thermostat or water pump (liquid-cooled bikes)
entry.rider_advice_en: Pull over safely, switch off and do not keep riding; have the bike taken to a workshop. Open the radiator cap at once to let the steam out and add cold water.
entry.can_ride_reason: overheating can destroy the engine; arrange transport
technician_hints_en: Check the engine oil level and the coolant level (liquid-cooled bikes)
Look for a lean mixture and for blocked airflow around the engine

attacks.label: Brake fluid loss implied by an ABS pump entry that stays SERVICE_SOON (nothing checks braking hydraulics)
proposed_messages: Q6 braking hydraulics 'brake fluid' in 'Low brake fluid or a leaking brake line', not in the source
Q6 braking hydraulics 'brake fluid' in 'Check the brake fluid level and top it u', not in the source

entry.meaning_en: The ABS control unit found an electrical fault in the ABS pump motor circuit, so ABS is probably switched off.
likely_causes_en: Low brake fluid or a leaking brake line
Pump motor seized after long inactivity
entry.rider_advice_en: Your normal brakes still work, but ABS is off, so a wheel can lock in hard braking. Ride gently, brake early, avoid wet roads and get it checked soon.
entry.can_ride_reason: brakes work but no ABS; ride gently, brake early, avoid wet roads
technician_hints_en: Check the brake fluid level and top it up if it is low
Check the ABS pump motor supply and ground connections

attacks.label: Bonus: wheel position named in meaning and hint of a wheel speed entry (owner rule: position-neutral)
proposed_messages: Q7 wheel position 'left' in 'Replace the left front wheel speed senso'

entry.meaning_en: The ABS control unit found a fault in the left front wheel speed sensor, so ABS is probably switched off.
entry.rider_advice_en: Your normal brakes still work, but ABS is off, so a wheel can lock in hard braking. Ride gently, brake early, avoid wet roads and get it checked soon.
entry.can_ride_reason: brakes work but no ABS; ride gently, brake early, avoid wet roads
technician_hints_en: Replace the left front wheel speed sensor first
Check the sensor signal on the scan tool while the wheel turns

attacks.label: Bonus: can_ride_reason contradicts the level and the entry's own warning (lean mixture overheats the engine)
proposed_messages: Q8 with_care entry permits normal riding in can_ride_reason: 'ride normally'

entry.standard_title_en: System Too Lean Off Idle Bank 1
entry.meaning_en: The bike's computer (ECU) has to add a lot of fuel above idle, so the engine is getting too much air or too little fuel.
likely_causes_en: Weak fuel pump or low fuel pressure
entry.rider_advice_en: The engine may hesitate, run rough or lose power, and a lean mixture can overheat the engine. Get it checked soon and avoid hard or long rides until it is fixed.
entry.can_ride_reason: ride normally; long trips are fine
technician_hints_en: Look for cracked intake boots and loose clamps
Check fuel supply and injector condition
Compare the fuel trim values at idle and at steady cruise
